### Pipeline 4: Branch Continuation From Repaired Frame K (`Carry` / `Pivot` / `Lip-Sync`)
**Purpose:** Resumes the shot seamlessly from your repaired **Frame K** while keeping the locked prefix (`Frames 0 .. K-1`) mathematically untouched.

- **Mode 1 & 2 — `carry` or `pivot` (Nodes 1–18):**
  - Feeds `Frame K Repaired` into Wan 2.2 Dual-Expert MoE with automatic **`4k + 1` padding** (e.g., if 36 frames remain, Node `12` requests `37` frames).
  - **Node 16 (`ColorMatch`)** locks the generated tail's color temperature and exposure to `Frame K Repaired` so lighting never shifts across the cut.
  - **Node 17 (`ImageFromBatch`)** drops index `0` (which duplicates `Frame K`) and trims any `4k + 1` padding before lossless FFV1 stitching.
- **Mode 3 — `lipsync` Fast Bypass (Nodes 19–22):**
  - Skips full 14B video re-generation! Loads the existing motion tail + a `.wav` dialogue line into **LatentSync 1.6** (Node `21`) to re-animate only the lower face/lips in seconds.

_meta.title: 📖 READ FIRST — Pipeline 4: Seamless Continuation & Lip-Sync
_meta.description: Explains 4k+1 tail math, duplicate frame-0 dropping, MKL color matching, and the LatentSync 1.6 dialogue bypass.

_meta.title: [1] Load Approved Repaired Frame K (New Tail Start)
_meta.description: Acts as frame 0 of the new continuation tail so the repaired anatomy/expression carries forward.

_meta.title: [2] Load Optional Pivot End Frame Anchor
_meta.description: Optional target landing keyframe when redirecting the shot's ending in 'pivot' mode.

_meta.title: [3] Load UMT5-XXL Text Encoder
_meta.description: Encodes the continuation or pivoted action prompt.

_meta.title: [4] Load Wan 3D Causal Video VAE
_meta.description: 3D temporal VAE requiring 4k + 1 frame counts.

inputs.text: character continues action smoothly with natural motion and film lighting

_meta.title: [5] Continuation / Pivot Motion Prompt
_meta.description: In 'carry' mode, keeps original motion; in 'pivot' mode, describes the new story direction from Frame K onward.

inputs.text: jump cut, face morph, flicker, extra limbs, distorted hands

_meta.title: [6] Continuation Negative Prompt
_meta.description: Prevents jump-cut pops, facial drift, and hand regression in the branched tail.

_meta.title: [7] Load Wan 2.2 High-Noise 14B Expert
_meta.description: Pass 1 expert establishing smooth motion trajectory out of Frame K.

_meta.title: [8] Load Wan 2.2 Low-Noise 14B Expert
_meta.description: Pass 2 expert preserving fine identity and the repaired details.

_meta.title: [9] Character Wan 2.2 Low-Noise LoRA (0.85)
_meta.description: Keeps character likeness consistent across the continuation tail.

_meta.title: [10] High-Noise Flow-Match Shift (6.0)
_meta.description: Timestep shift for Pass 1.

_meta.title: [11] Low-Noise Flow-Match Shift (6.0)
_meta.description: Timestep shift for Pass 2.

_meta.title: [12] Wan 2.2 Tail Conditioning (Auto-Padded to 4k + 1)
_meta.description: Shot Director automatically computes length = ceil(remaining / 4) * 4 + 1 (e.g., 37 requested to yield 36 new tail frames).

_meta.title: [13] MoE Pass 1: High-Noise Tail Sampler (Steps 0 -> 12)
_meta.description: Generates the macro motion continuation from Frame K.

_meta.title: [14] MoE Pass 2: Low-Noise Tail Sampler (Steps 12 -> 24)
_meta.description: Refines facial likeness and surface textures across the tail.

_meta.title: [15] Decode Tail Video Latents
_meta.description: Decodes the 4k + 1 continuation batch to RGB frames.

_meta.title: [16] MKL Color-Grade Lock to Repaired Frame K (0.85)
_meta.description: Prevents subtle exposure or color-temperature drift across the splice point.

_meta.title: [17] Drop Duplicate Frame 0 & Trim Exact Remaining Length
_meta.description: Skips batch_index 0 (avoiding a 2-frame freeze on Frame K) and trims any 4k+1 padding frames.

_meta.title: [18] Save Lossless Tail (FFV1 .mkv for Prefix Concatenation)
_meta.description: Spliced losslessly onto locked Frames 0..K-1 + Repaired Frame K by Shot Director.

inputs.text:
### Fast Lip-Sync Bypass Subgraph (Nodes 19–22)
When you choose **`mode = "lipsync"`**, you already like the body and camera motion — you just want the character to speak a `.wav` dialogue line from `~/ComfyFactory/voices/`.

**LatentSync 1.6 (Node 21)** re-synthesizes only the mouth and jaw region synchronized to your audio waveform, leaving eyes, hair, and background untouched.

_meta.title: 🎙️ LIP-SYNC MODE SUBGRAPH (LatentSync 1.6)
_meta.description: Explains the fast audio-driven lip-sync branch.

_meta.title: [19] Load Existing Tail Video (Frames K .. N)
_meta.description: Loads the video segment starting at Frame K to apply lip synchronization.

_meta.title: [20] Load Spoken Dialogue WAV
_meta.description: Clean mono/stereo speech WAV uploaded from ~/ComfyFactory/voices/.

_meta.title: [21] LatentSync 1.6 Audio-Driven Mouth Synthesis (1.5x Expression)
_meta.description: Synchronizes lip and jaw articulation to the dialogue audio. Lower lips_expression (1.1–1.3) for subtle speech; raise (1.5–1.8) for dramatic projection.

_meta.title: [22] Save Lossless Lip-Synced Tail + Audio (.mkv)
_meta.description: Outputs the lip-synced tail with embedded audio for lossless splicing onto the shot prefix.
